statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-43868 (GHSA-2f9f-gq7v-9h6m) is an excessive allocation on a size value read by the Rust thrift protocol decoder, fixed in thrift 0.23.0. Milvus 3.0 includes thrift 0.17.0 through the parquet crates (56, 57 and 58) that the milvus-storage bridge uses to read Parquet footers, and every parquet release the bridge's dependencies (lance, iceberg, paimon) accept pins thrift 0.17, so moving it is an upstream dependency migration under evaluation. CVE-2026-43868 (GHSA-2f9f-gq7v-9h6m) is an excessive allocation on a size value read by the Rust thrift protocol decoder, fixed in thrift 0.23.0. Milvus 3.0 includes thrift 0.17.0 through the parquet crates (56, 57 and 58) that the milvus-storage bridge uses to read Parquet footers, and every parquet release the bridge's dependencies (lance, iceberg, paimon) accept pins thrift 0.17, so moving it is an upstream dependency migration under evaluation. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-2f9f-gq7v-9h6m
No fixed version is currently published for the thrift crate; scanner metadata marks versions through 0.22.0 as affected. Waiting for upstream fix.
